notes.title: Patch to Fix Library Installation Issues
notes.content: Fixed an issue with library installation.  As part of the fix I had to change the process used to install libraries.  Instructions will be provided that show you how the new process works.

notes.title: Minor update (12.1.0)
notes.content: This update fixes a issue with installing the 1999 library and upgrades the 1920 season to V12.

notes.title: Patch 12.1.0 Has Been Released
notes.content:
This patch contains the following updates and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Added an Encyclopedia Options group located in the Advanced Options section.  This new option group allows the user to edit the MinPA and MinIP parameters used by the Encyclopedia report.
[*] Fixed a bug that resulted in the Strikeout Looking sound to fire when a runner steals a base.
[*] Updated the 1984 library to add a missing trade.  Specifically, a trade that sent Bill Scherrer to the Tigers (on 8/28) for Carl Willis (on 9/1).
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 12.0.9 Has Been Released!
notes.content:
The following bug fixes and updates are included in this patch:

[list]
[*]The default value of the "Clear Schedule" checkbox on the Schedule Editor is now unchecked.  This ensures that users do not accidentally clear the schedule when importing.  If you want to clear the current schedule when importing you now have to check the box first.
[*]Code changes were implemented to support the new Baseball Reference import format.  These code changes will clean up any pseudo teams that get created by the new format.
[*]Fixed the "Lineout to the Infield" command.  Specifically, the command now correctly handles a lineout to third base followed by a throwing error (L5 ET).
[*]Correction made to the Pitching Leaders report.  The K/BB column is no longer rounded up to the nearest integer.
[*]Fixed an issue with the pitch/swing buttons getting disabled when entering nothing in the manual dice roll dialog.  This would happen when the CM was controlling the batting team and the user was controlling the fielding team.
[*]Updated the "Infield Throwing Error" command to support baserunners getting thrown out when advancing on an error.  For example, with a runner on first ET54 R12 R0X1 results in the third baseman fielding a ground ball and committing a throwing error when attempting to get the runner at second. The runner takes third on the error (R12) and the batter is out attempting to take second on the play (R0X1).  The Board Game Companion Guide has been updated to document the update (Version 12.2).
[*]Added support for a G333 double play (unassisted double play by the first baseman).
[*]Fixed a bug with the code that assigns runs/unearned-runs to pitchers when a runner is out on a fielder's choice after a pitching change.  Specifically, the following rule is now correctly implemented: When pitchers are changed during an inning, the Official Scorer shall not charge the relief pitcher with any run (earned or unearned) for runs scored by any runner who reaches base on a fielder’s choice that puts out a runner left on base by any preceding pitcher.
[*]Typos corrected in the Play By Play. 
[/list]
Thanks to all for providing feedback!  Play ball!

notes.title: Update 12.0.5 has been released!
notes.content:
[b]Update 12.0.5 has been released![/b]

[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Users can now filter pitching and batting reports based on a date range.  Range reports can be generated by setting the Month/Date property of the report to Date Range.  Then, when you click on the View button you will be asked to provide the date range.
[*] Added a Statis Pro option that allows the user to choose between two methods of assigning CD ratings based on DDBB range ratings.  The V12 method (the default) assigns CD ratings based on range ratings and fielding pct.  When the range rating is 3, the CD rating is based on the player's fielding percentage.  The V11 method assigns CD ratings strictly on range rating, and range ratings of 3 are assigned a CD2.
[*]Users can now export player notes.  The generated CSV files can then be edited and imported into the library.  This is a great way to add/edit player notes to your library.  When you export the notes, individual files will be generated for each team, and one big file will be saved that contains all players in the library.
[*]Added a gear icon located on the Season Overview page (just above the leader boards).  Clicking on that icon allows you to specify how many players you want to be listed on the leader boards.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a typo in the confirmation message when exporting opening day rosters.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused missing columns (W, L, G, GS) in pitching reports that list players.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the transaction page from loading when one or more teams in the organization do not have players.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused batting columns SH and SF to be out of sync when the user reorders the columns.
[*]Fixed the formatting of Statis Pro Advanced cards so that they fit on the screen better on certain resolutions.  Specifically, the BD ranges are now listed as BDH (clutch HR), BD3 (clutch 3B), and BD2 (clutch 2B), and the list of positions played has been reformatted to take up less space.  This extra space prevents the lines from wrapping around on certain resolutions.
[*]Fixed an bug with the calculation of some columns on the "All Career Batting" encyclopedia report.
[*]Fixed a bug with Statis Pro Basic cards that are generated for fielders who are also "one-off" emergency pitchers.
[*]Fixed the FCET command so it works correctly when there are 2 outs.  
[*]Fixed a bug with the double play totals on fielding reports.
[*]Fixed an issue with the calculation of RF9 on fielding reports.
[*]Fixed the format of fielding percentage totals on fielding reports.
[*]Added a confirmation message when Statis Pro Basic PDFs are successfully generated.
[*]Fixed a bug with some stats in the fielding reports when the schedule contains inter-league games.
[/list]
Thanks to everyone for your feedback.  Play ball!

notes.title: 12.0.4 Update
notes.content:
This update contains the following:

[list]
[*] The Player Notes feature has been expanded to allow users add notes based on each position.  In addition, the importing tool for importing notes was updated to support the expanded notes.  The notes import dialog box on the player editor contains the new import format that is supported.
[*] Several improvements and bug fixes to the Ask the Manager feature.  The User Guide was updated to cover this new feature.  You can also view the video [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jWwrqUahOo8]here[/url].   
[*] Fixed an issue in the fielding report with RFG getting rounded down to the nearest integer.
[*] Fixed an issue with IP getting formatted incorrectly in the pitching leader reports.
[*] Pickoffs were added to the advanced pitching reports.
[*] Fixed an issue with leader reports when there is inter-league play.
[*] H9, HR9, and BB9 are now reported in ascending order in the pitching leader reports.
[*] Fixed the play by play on a "F9 R3S R2X" play (runner on third safely tags up, but runner on second is thrown out).
[*] Fixed an issue with the game engine never generating 'called strikeouts'.  The engine is now recording ~25% of the strikeouts as called strikeouts.
[*] Fixed a missing play by play issue when the user enters GX6 with the bases loaded and no outs.
[*] Completed improvements to the pickoff logic so pickoff totals better match real life totals.  In addition, the option that allows users to adjust the likelihood of a pickoff has been widened, giving users more control.  That option is in the Advanced->Base Running Options Group.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone for your feedback.  Play Ball!

notes.title: Patch 12.0.3 Released
notes.content:
This patch contains the following improvements and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Several report improvements and bug fixes.
[*] The bench/pen dialog box now shows the next three batters up for the opponent.
[*] The hotkey for a bunt has changed to ctl+n.
[*] Fixed an issue with the display of Statis-Pro/Statis-ProAdv cards in the player popup.
[*] Added the CSV file formats to several dialog boxes so users can easily see the CSV formats that are supported (e.g., importing a schedule, importing custom ratings, etc.).
[*] When users are starting a game, and they attempt to change the DH rule, a tip is now displayed that tells the user how to make the change.
[*] Added an "Are you sure?" message box when a user attempts to undo a game.
[*] Updated the foul out command to allow all fielders.
[*] Fixed an issue where it was impossible to use the ask-the-manager feature when the inning started with a required pitcher replacement (i.e, the pitcher was pinch hit for in the previous inning).  Now the user can use the ask-the-manager feature in that situation by using the hot key ctl+t.  This hot key will also work when the bench/pen dialog is up.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the ask-the-manager would actually make defensive replacements for you instead of just suggesting it.
[*] Improvements were made to the ask-the-manager feature when the manager is suggesting a new pitcher.  Specifically, if you ask the manager multiple times they might suggest different relievers.  In addition, the manager will try to suggest the pitcher with the least amount of residual fatigue when possible.
[*] Added new in-game font and size options.  Users can use these options to fine-tune the font size and window height of the batter/pitcher stat tables displayed above the lineup.  In addition, all of the existing in-game font/size adjustments result in slightly larger components.
[*] Fixed the fielder location file for the 1978 Texas Ranger ballpark.
[*] Corrected a few typos in the user interface.
[/list]
The next patch is scheduled for 5/27.

Thanks to everyone who provided feedback for this patch!

notes.title: Patch 12.0.2 Released!
notes.content:
This patch contains the following bug fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Several fixes and improvements to the V12 reports feature.
[*] The Team Editor now displays each team's simulated W/L record and also allows the user to edit the W/L record. 
[*] Fixed a bug with the undo game feature that can result in an incorrect team W/L record.  If you have used the undo game feature on a game, be sure to check the team records for the teams involved in the game.  If the records are incorrect, you can easily fix them using the Team Editor.  In some cases, the record displayed on the Day View Calendar may display an incorrect record around the time of the undo.  This will correct itself for games played after the patch.
[*] Fixed an issue with game summary edits containing a single quote.
[*] Changed to the color of the runners on base "dots" displayed to the left of the line score during a game.  The new color is much easier to see.
[*] Fixed a few typos in the play by play.
[*] Tweaked the auto-scaling for 1920 x 1080 resolutions.  
[/list]
Thanks to all who provided feedback for this patch.  The next patch is scheduled for 5/13.

notes.title: Patch 12.0.1 Released!
notes.content:
This patch contains the following bug fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Several bug fixes and improvements to the reporting system.
[*] Added missing play by play on G336 and G334 double plays.
[*] Add two new rare plays.  Go to the Chart Editor, select the "Board Game Companion Commands" Chart Group, and then click on "Reset All Commands" to enable the new plays. 
[*] Fixed a bug with the display of the combined Statis Pro card in the player popup. 
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the user from swapping lineup slots with the DH spot.
[*] Fixed a crash when updating an encyclopedia and there is a league without teams.
[*] Fixed an issue with the in-game display on 2880 X 1920 resolution.
[*] The hot key for "Ask the Manager" was changed to coltrol+t because control+a is already a hotkey in Windows (it "selects all").
[*] Fixed an issue with the FD7 shortcut when there is a runner on first.
[*] Fixed an endless "Please Wait" that takes place on some hardware when when starting a game, just after committing the starting pitchers.
[/list]
Shutdown Steam and Digital Diamond Baseball, then restart Steam to get the update.  

Next patch scheduled for 5/6.

Play Ball!
